ACCELERATOR_PEDAL.note: Accelerator pedal travel. 0 is not depressed and 100 is fully depressed. Throttle plate position is TPS.

AUX_BATTERY_VOLTAGE.note: 12 V low-voltage battery. OBD control-module voltage is MODULE_VOLTAGE.

BATTERY_LEVEL.note: Customer-displayed state of charge. Physical state of charge is StateOfCharge.Current.

BOOST_PRESSURE.reason: Derived as MAP minus BARO; VSS has no separate boost-pressure signal.

BRAKE_PEDAL.note: Brake pedal travel. 0 is not depressed and 100 is fully depressed. Brake lamps are BRAKE_LIGHTS.

CABIN_TEMP_SETPOINT.reason: The station is not fixed. Use DRIVER_TEMP_SETTING or PASSENGER_TEMP_SETTING.

CHARGER.note: Single charging port. Use a position instance instead of AnyPosition when the port location is known.

CHARGER_CURRENT.note: DC inlet current. AC current is Phase1, Phase2, and Phase3.

CHARGER_POWER.note: Average power of the current or last charging event.

CHARGER_TYPE.reason: Active connected charger type (none, ac, dc) has no single VSS signal; SupportedInletTypes is an attribute array.

CHARGER_VOLTAGE.note: DC inlet voltage. AC voltage is Phase1, Phase2, and Phase3.

CHARGE_ENERGY_ADDED.reason: Session energy added has no VSS signal. Vehicle.Powertrain.TractionBattery.AccumulatedChargedEnergy is lifetime charged energy.

CHARGE_PORT.note: Single charging port. Use a position instance instead of AnyPosition when the port location is known.

CHARGE_PORT_CLOSE.note: Single charging port. Use a position instance instead of AnyPosition when the port location is known.

CHARGE_PORT_OPEN.note: Single charging port. Use a position instance instead of AnyPosition when the port location is known.

CHARGE_POWER.note: Average power of the current or last charging event.

CHARGE_TIME_REMAINING.note: Includes a scheduled delay before charging starts.

CHARGING.note: Active charging status. Start/stop commands map to Vehicle.Powertrain.TractionBattery.Charging.StartStopCharging.

CHARGING_STATE.reason: disconnected, stopped, charging, and complete do not match Vehicle.Powertrain.TractionBattery.ChargingState.

CLIMATE.reason: No single climate power actuator. Air conditioning is Vehicle.Cabin.HVAC.IsAirConditioningActive.

CLIMATE_OFF.reason: No single climate power actuator. Air conditioning is Vehicle.Cabin.HVAC.IsAirConditioningActive.

CLIMATE_ON.reason: No single climate power actuator. Air conditioning is Vehicle.Cabin.HVAC.IsAirConditioningActive.

CLOSE_FRONT_LEFT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed.

CLOSE_FRONT_RIGHT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed.

CLOSE_FRUNK.note: Front luggage compartment. Vehicle.Body.Hood is the engine cover.

CLOSE_REAR_LEFT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed.

CLOSE_REAR_RIGHT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed.

CLUTCH_PEDAL.note: Clutch pedal travel. 0 is not depressed and 100 is fully depressed. Clutch engagement is Vehicle.Powertrain.Transmission.ClutchEngagement.

CRUISE_CONTROL.note: Cruise control engaged. Master switch is Vehicle.ADAS.CruiseControl.IsEnabled.

DEFROST_OFF.note: Front defroster. Rear defroster is Vehicle.Cabin.HVAC.IsRearDefrosterActive.

DEFROST_ON.note: Front defroster. Rear defroster is Vehicle.Cabin.HVAC.IsRearDefrosterActive.

DRIVER_TORQUE_DEMAND.reason: OBD driver-demand engine torque (PID 61) is not in the VSS 6.1 catalog or the OBD overlay.

ENGINE.note: Engine rotating. Remote start is action REMOTE_START.

ESTIMATED_RANGE.note: Remaining range from all energy sources.

FOG_LIGHTS.note: Front fog lights. Rear fog lights are Vehicle.Body.Lights.Fog.Rear.IsOn.

FRONT_DEFROST.note: Front defroster. Rear defroster is REAR_DEFROST.

FRONT_LEFT_DOOR.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

FRONT_LEFT_DOOR_OPEN.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

FRONT_LEFT_SEATBELT.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

FRONT_LEFT_SEAT_HEATER.reason: Vehicle.Cabin.Seat.Row1.DriverSide.HeatingCooling is a signed percent (-100 to 100), not discrete off/low/medium/high levels.

FRONT_LEFT_WINDOW.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. Travel in percent is FRONT_LEFT_WINDOW_POSITION.

FRONT_LEFT_WINDOW_POSITION.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed and 100 is fully open.

FRONT_RIGHT_DOOR.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

FRONT_RIGHT_DOOR_OPEN.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

FRONT_RIGHT_SEATBELT.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

FRONT_RIGHT_SEAT_HEATER.reason: Vehicle.Cabin.Seat.Row1.PassengerSide.HeatingCooling is a signed percent (-100 to 100), not discrete off/low/medium/high levels.

FRONT_RIGHT_WINDOW.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. Travel in percent is FRONT_RIGHT_WINDOW_POSITION.

FRONT_RIGHT_WINDOW_POSITION.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed and 100 is fully open.

FUEL_RATE.note: Engine fuel rate. COVESA OBD overlay, PID 5E. FuelSystem.InstantConsumption is l/100km.

GEAR.note: Selected gear. 126 = park, -1 = reverse, 0 = neutral, 127 = drive.

HOOD.note: Engine cover. Front luggage compartment is Vehicle.Body.Trunk.Front.IsOpen.

HV_BATTERY_CAPACITY.note: Net usable capacity. Gross capacity is Vehicle.Powertrain.TractionBattery.GrossCapacity.

HV_BATTERY_POWER.reason: Vehicle.Powertrain.TractionBattery.CurrentPower is in W, while HV_BATTERY_POWER is in kW.

HV_BATTERY_SOC.note: Customer-displayed state of charge. Physical state of charge is StateOfCharge.Current.

IDEAL_RANGE.reason: VSS has no ideal or rated range separate from remaining range.

IGNITION.note: Power mode. Allowed values are UNDEFINED, LOCK, OFF, ACC, ON, and START.

LAMBDA.note: First wideband oxygen sensor, PID 24. Sensors 2 through 8 are Vehicle.OBD.O2WR.Sensor2.Lambda through Sensor8.Lambda.

MIL_STATUS.note: Malfunction indicator lamp. COVESA OBD overlay, PID 01.

MIRRORS.reason: VSS separates side mirrors into Vehicle.Body.Mirrors.DriverSide.IsFolded and PassengerSide.IsFolded.

O2_DATA.note: First narrowband sensor voltage, PID 14 byte A. Short-term trim is Vehicle.OBD.O2.Sensor1.ShortTermFuelTrim. Sensors 2 through 8 follow the same shape.

OIL_PRESSURE.reason: VSS has EngineOil.PressureStatus (string), not a numeric kPa oil-pressure signal.

OPEN_FRONT_LEFT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 100 is fully open when the command does not select a percent.

OPEN_FRONT_RIGHT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 100 is fully open when the command does not select a percent.

OPEN_FRUNK.note: Front luggage compartment. Vehicle.Body.Hood is the engine cover.

OPEN_REAR_LEFT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 100 is fully open when the command does not select a percent.

OPEN_REAR_RIGHT_WINDOW.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 100 is fully open when the command does not select a percent.

PLUGGED_IN.note: Single charging port. Use a position instance instead of AnyPosition when the port location is known.

RANGE.note: Remaining range from all energy sources.

READINESS_STATUS.reason: OBD readiness monitors are a bitmap in PID 01 and are not a single signal. MIL state is Vehicle.OBD.Status.IsMILOn.

READY.reason: VSS has no propulsion-ready state signal; Vehicle.IsMoving only indicates motion.

REAR_DEFROST.note: Rear defroster. Front defroster is FRONT_DEFROST.

REAR_LEFT_DOOR.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

REAR_LEFT_DOOR_OPEN.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

REAR_LEFT_WINDOW.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. Travel in percent is REAR_LEFT_WINDOW_POSITION.

REAR_LEFT_WINDOW_POSITION.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed and 100 is fully open.

REAR_RIGHT_DOOR.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

REAR_RIGHT_DOOR_OPEN.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability.

REAR_RIGHT_WINDOW.note: Closed and open. Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. Travel in percent is REAR_RIGHT_WINDOW_POSITION.

REAR_RIGHT_WINDOW_POSITION.note: Left/right mapping assumes left-hand-drive; review vehicle applicability. 0 is fully closed and 100 is fully open.

REAR_WIPER.note: Rear windshield. Use MEDIUM when the command does not select a speed.

RUNTIME.note: Engine run time. COVESA OBD overlay, PID 1F.

SEATBELT_WARNING.note: Vehicle seatbelt warning indicator. True means the indicator is active. Per-seat buckle state remains IsBelted.

SET_CHARGE_LIMIT.reason: The limit is a caller-supplied value, not a fixed write target. The signal is Vehicle.Powertrain.TractionBattery.Charging.ChargeLimit.

SET_CHARGING_AMPS.reason: No commanded charging-current actuator. MaximumChargingCurrent is inlet capability, not a setpoint.

SET_TEMPERATURE.reason: The station is not fixed. Use DRIVER_TEMP_SETTING or PASSENGER_TEMP_SETTING.

SUNROOF.note: Switch command/state. Travel in percent is SUNROOF_POSITION.

SUNROOF_POSITION.note: 0 is fully closed, 100 is fully opened, and -100 is fully tilted.

TIME_TO_FULL_CHARGE.note: Includes a scheduled delay before charging starts.

TIMING_ADVANCE.note: COVESA OBD overlay, PID 0E. The value is the angle, not the raw OBD byte.

TRUNK.note: Rear luggage compartment. False is closed and true is open. The action opens the trunk.

WINDOW_CHILD_LOCK.note: Disables the rear window switches so only the driver can operate them.

WIPERS.note: Front windshield. Use MEDIUM when the command does not select a speed.
